title: Horizon Industrial Parks reports consolidated net loss of Rs 10.32 crore in the June 2026 quarter
text: Horizon Industrial Parks reports consolidated net loss of Rs 10.32 crore in the June 2026 quarter. Sales rise 55.92% to Rs 200.55 crore
